source: WHATWG URL Standard, the application/x-www-form-urlencoded serializer (https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer): bytes A-Z a-z 0-9 * - . _ are literal, space is +, everything else is %XX in upper-case hex. nodejs-sdk@c0ff3fd packages/core/src/body/simple-bodies.test.ts encodes with RFC 3986 and then rewrites %20 to +, which differs from WHATWG on ~ (WHATWG: %7E, Node: literal) and on * (WHATWG: literal, Node: %2A); these vectors follow WHATWG.
note: fields is a list of [name, value] pairs encoded in order; wire is the exact output. rejects=true means Encode throws ArgumentException; in a rejecting case the marker <U+D800> inside a string stands for the lone high surrogate U+D800, which JSON cannot carry portably.
